It is advised that you read the full description of the source material of any interesting item for a better understanding of what it is. This document is only a quick reference.
Keyword ReferenceAll qualities are based on their earliest appearance unless otherwise specified. Qualities marked with * apply to Black Crusade / Only War / Dark Heresy 2E.
AccurateGrants an additional +10 when used with the Aim action. On an aimed single shot with a Basic weapon, gain 1d10 extra damage for every 2 Degrees of Success (maximum 2d10).
Accurate*Grants an additional +10 when used with the Aim action. On an aimed single shot with a Basic weapon, gain 1d10 extra damage for every 2 Degrees of Success (maximum 2d10). These additional d10s cannot generate Zealous Hatred / Righteous Fury.
BalancedGrants a +10 to WS tests made to parry.
Balanced*Grants a +10 to WS tests made to parry. Multiple Balanced weapons only grant this bonus once.
Blast (X)Hits all targets in X radius. Roll for hit location and damage individually.
Blast (X)*Hits all targets in X radius. Roll damage once and apply it to all affected targets.
Blast (X) [DH2]Hits all targets in X radius. Roll damage once and apply it to all affected targets. Missed attacks scatter (DH2 230).
Cleansing FireTargets must make a Willpower test or catch fire. On weapons with the Flame quality, targets take an extra 1d10E damage (ignoring Armor/Toughness) when they fail to put out the flames.
ConcussiveStuns a target. Target must make a Toughness test at -10 per DoS on hit or be stunned for 1 round. Auditory protection grants +10 to resist stunning sound, but not the kinetic effect. Targets taking more than [Strength Bonus] damage are knocked Prone.
Concussive*Stuns a target. Target must make a Toughness test (-10 per X) on hit or be stunned for 1 round per Degree of Failure. Targets taking more than [Strength Bonus] damage are knocked Prone.
CorrosiveReduces target's AP by 1d10 per hit until repaired with a Tech-Use test. Targets reduced to 0 AP take the extra reduction as Wounds (ignoring Toughness).
CustomizedHalves reload time (if longer than a Half Action).
Crippling (X)When a target suffers at least one wound from a weapon with this quality, they become "crippled" for the remainder of the encounter, or until healed of all damage, whichever comes first. If a character takes more than a Half Action while Crippled, they suffer X in Rending damage to the same location, with no reduction for Armor or Toughness.
DaemonbaneAttacks against Daemonic enemies bypass Toughness bonus and gain the Vengeful (8) quality.
Deadly SnareThe weapon envelops the target in snares which not only constrict but seek to strangle and flay their victim. This weapon quality functions in the same way as the Snare weapon quality, except that any character entangled by the weapon suffers the weapons damage again in their turn every round if they do not break free.
Decay (X)Living targets that take Critical Damage (including Zealous Hatred) from this weapon must make a Toughness test (-10 per X) or dissolve into a puddle of gore.
DefensiveThe weapon gains +15 to Parry, but takes a -10 penalty when attacking.
Devastating (X)Reduce one additional point of Cohesion if hit, regardless of wounds or damage. If Horde, reduce magnitude by X per hit.
Devastating (X) [BC]A Horde hit and damaged by a weapon with this quality reduces its Magnitude by X.
DisintegrateA victim suffering critical damage from this weapon is completely destroyed.
ExcruciatingTargets damaged by a weapon with this trait must pass a -10 WP or T test (target's choice) or be stunned for one round.
FastOpponents suffer a -20 to Parry a weapon with this quality.
Felling (X)Ignore one level of Unnatural Toughness per X.
FlameThe wielder doesn't test BS, instead, all creatures in 30 degree arc test must Agility or take a hit. If hit, test Agility again or be set on fire. This ignores cover. If you do not have the proper talent, the targets get +20 to avoid, or +30 if unbraced Heavy. For DH and RT: Hit body only, jams on 9.
Flame [BC]Targets hit by a Flame attack must pass an Agility test or be set on fire.
Flame [OW]Characters hit by a Flame attack must pass an Agility test or be set on fire. Vehicle pilots must make an Operate test with a bonus equal to the Armor on the side hit or catch fire (OW 284).
FlexibleWeapons with this quality cannot be parried.
ForceCounts as a Best Craftsmanship Mono version of a standard Primitive weapon. In the hands of a psyker, add +1 Damage and Pen per point of Psy Rating and change the damage type to E. When the wielder damages an opponent, he may make a Focus Power test (Opposed Willpower) as a Free Action. If he succeeds with more Degrees of Success than his opponent, he deals an additional 1d10E damage per Degree of Success, ignoring armor and Toughness. Force weapons cannot be destroyed by Power Fields.
Force [BC]Any Melee weapon with the Primitive quality may be a Force weapon. This increases the availability to Extremely Rare. In the hands of a psyker, add +1 Damage and Pen per point of Psy Rating and ignore the Primitive quality. When the wielder damages an opponent, he may make a Focus Power test (Opposed Willpower) as a Free Action. If he succeeds, he deals an additional 1d10E damage per Degree of Success, ignoring armor and Toughness. Can't be destroyed by Power Fields.
Force [OW]Counts as a Best Craftsmanship Mono version of a standard Low-Tech weapon. In the hands of a psyker, add +1 Damage and Pen per point of Psy Rating and change the damage type to E. When the wielder damages an opponent, he may make a Focus Power test (Opposed Willpower) as a Half Action. If he succeeds, he deals an additional 1d10E damage per Degree of Success, ignoring armor and Toughness. Can't be destroyed by Power Fields.
Force [DH2]Counts as a Best Craftsmanship Mono version of a standard Low-Tech weapon. In the hands of a psyker, add +1 Damage and Pen per point of base Psy Rating and change the damage type to E. When the wielder damages an opponent, he may make a Focus Power test (Opposed Willpower) as a Half Action. This test can't trigger Psychic Phenomena. If he succeeds, he deals an additional 1d10E damage per Degree of Success, ignoring armor and Toughness. Can't be destroyed by Power Fields.
GaussGauss weapons generate Zealous Hatred on a 9 or 10, and if they would not deal damage when generating Zealous Hatred, they deal 1d5 Wounds instead of 1. In addition, they generate Zealous Hatred against vehicles on a 9 or 0, even if they do not deal damage.
GravitonDeals additional damage equal to target's AP. Critical Hit rolls against vehicles always use the Motive Systems table.
Gyro-StabilisedNever counts as further than Long Range (penalty still applies, as does normal maximum range). Heavy Weapons with this Quality reduce the penalty for firing without Bracing to -20
Hallucinogenic (X)Anyone hit by this weapon must make a Toughness test (-10 per X) or suffer a delusion (BC 150, OW 170, DH2 146). Respirators and sealed armor grant +20 to resist. This effect lasts 1 round, plus 1 per Degree of Failure.
Haywire (X)Everything in X radius goes haywire. Roll for effect (TLW 61, DW 143). Effects lessen by one step per round.
Haywire (X)*Everything in X radius goes haywire. Roll for effect (BC 151, OW 171, DH2 147). Effects lessen by one step per round. If multiple Haywire areas overlap, only the strongest effect applies.
InaccurateGain no bonus for Aiming.
Indirect (X)Can attack targets beyond line of sight by taking a -10 penalty and a Full Action to fire. Successful attacks scatter (OW 255) and land anywhere within 1d10-[BS Bonus] meters; missed shots land within Xd10 meters. The gunner's Comrade may take a Full Action to remove the -10 penalty and reduce the missed scatter distance to Xd5.
Indirect (X)Can attack targets beyond line of sight by taking a -10 penalty and a Full Action to fire. Successful attacks scatter (DH2 230) and land anywhere within 1d10-[BS Bonus] meters; missed shots land within Xd10 meters.
IntegratedIntegrated weapons need to be connected to the wielder's potentia coil. Without it, they quickly lose power. Integrated weapons need a special Weapon Training talent to use. See text (TLW 58, SOH 125) for more info.
Irradiated (X)Anyone hit by this weapon must make a Toughness test (-10 per X) or take 2d10 Toughness damage.
LanceMultiply the weapon's Penetration by [Degrees of Success + 1].
Living WeaponAdd an extra hit for each Degree of Success on the attack roll.
MaximalA weapon with this quality has two firing modes: normal and maximal. This must be chosen at the beginning of the round. On Maximal, add 10m to range, 1d10 to damage, and 2 to penetration. If it has blast, it is improved by 2. This shot uses three times as much ammunition, and temporarily adds the Recharge quality if it isn't already present.
MeltaDouble penetration when firing at Short range or closer.
Ogryn-ProofMay be used by characters with the Clumsy trait.
Overcharge (X)When firing, the wielder may choose to add (X) Damage and the Overheats quality.
Overcharge*The wielder may triple the weapon's ammo usage to add Concussive (+2), Devastating (+2), Overheats (on a roll of 86 or higher instead of 91), and Recharge.
OverheatsA roll of 91 or higher causes an overheat. When this happens, the wielder suffers energy damage equal to the weapon's damage with Pen 0 to the wielding arm, or a random arm if 2-handed. May avoid this by dropping the weapon as a Free Action. Must spend a round cooling down. Does not jam, and any effects that would cause it to instead cause an overheat.
Overheats [BC]A roll of 91 or higher causes an overheat. When this happens, the wielder suffers a single hit from the weapon to the wielding arm, or a random arm if 2-handed. Once the hit has been resolved, the wielder must then make an Agility test or drop the weapon. Must spend a round cooling down. Does not jam, and any effects that would cause it to instead cause an overheat.
Power FieldOn a successful Parry test with this weapon, there is a 75% chance the offending weapon will be destroyed. Warp Weapons, Natural Weapons, and Power Weapons are immune.
Power Field [BC]On a successful Parry test with or against this weapon, there is a 75% chance the offending weapon will be destroyed. Warp Weapons, Natural Weapons, and Power Weapons are immune.
PrimitiveAll AP from non-Primitive armor are doubled against weapons with this quality.
Primitive (X)*Weapons with this quality treat any rolled damage above X as X. A 10/0 is still required to trigger Zealous Hatred / Righteous Fury.
Proven (X)Treat any damage die roll lower than the rating as that rating. For example, if the weapon has Proven (3), and a 1 or 2 is rolled, treat it as a 3.
Razor SharpIf an attack results in 2 or more Degrees of Success, double the weapon's Penetration when resolving the hit.
Razor Sharp*If an attack results in 3 or more Degrees of Success, double the weapon's Penetration when resolving the hit.
ReactiveCollision with other matter does not stop the fusion reaction of this attack. The blast continues in a straight line out to the Range of the weapon. The firer may attempt to catch one additional target within 2 metres of the first with an additional -10 attack.
RechargeMay only fire every other round.
ReliableAny time the weapon would jam, roll 1d10. Any result lower than 10 negates the jam.
Reliable*Only jams on a roll of 100/00. Weapons with this quality that do not roll to hit never jam.
SanctifiedCounts as Holy, and has special effects on some Daemonic and Warp Creatures. Astartes weapons must be Exceptional or Master-Crafted to be Sanctified.
ScatterIf fired at a foe within Point Blank Range, every 2 Degrees of Success indicates another hit. However, double all armor point against hits from a Scatter weapon at Long or Extreme range.
Scatter*At Short Range or closer, +10 to hit. At Point Blank, +3 damage. At Long or Extreme Range, -3 damage (minimum 0).
ShockingA target that takes damage after AP and Toughness must make a Toughness test (+10 for every armor point on location) or be Stunned for [damage/2] rounds.
Shocking [BC]A target hit by a Shocking weapon must make a Toughness test or be Stunned for a number of rounds equal to his Degrees of Failure.
Shocking [OW]A target that takes damage after AP and Toughness must make a Toughness test or be Stunned for a number of rounds equal to his Degrees of Failure.
Shocking [DH2]A target that takes damage after AP and Toughness must make a Toughness test or be Stunned for [Degrees of Failure/2] rounds and take 1 Fatigue.
SmokeWhen a hit is scored, creates a cloud 3d10 meters in diameter centered on impact. It lasts 2d10 rounds or less.
Smoke (X)*When a hit is scored (not necessarily on a living target), it creates a smoke screen X meters in diameter. It lasts for 1d10+10 rounds, or less in adverse weather.
SnareOn hit, make an Agility test or be immobilized. Immobilized targets can't do anything except attempt escape (Strength or Agility test) and are helpless until free.
Snare (X)*On hit, make an Agility test (-10 per X) or be immobilized. Immobilized targets can't do anything except attempt escape (Strength or Agility test, same modifiers as the initial test) and are helpless until free.
SprayThis weapon does not need a test to fire. All creatures in the weapon's range, in a 30 degree arc, must make an Agility test or be struck by the attack and take damage normally. Cover offers no protection unless it conceals completely. Spray attacks always resolve against the body. They Jam if the firer rolls 9 on any damage dice (before bonuses).
Spray [DH2]This weapon does not need a test to fire. All creatures in the weapon's range, in a 30 degree arc, must make an Agility test or be struck by the attack and take damage normally. Targets get a +20 bonus on the Agility test if the wielder is untrained, or a +30 bonus if the weapon is Heavy and not braced. Cover offers no protection unless it conceals completely. Spray attacks always resolve against the body. They Jam if the firer rolls 9 on any damage dice (before bonuses).
StormThis doubles the number of hits inflicted on the target and ammo expended.
TaintedIncrease the weapon's damage by the 10s digit of the wielder's Corruption score.
Tainted [DH2]Increase the weapon's damage by the wielder's Daemonic (X) value or the 10s digit of their Corruption score, whichever is higher.
TearingRoll one extra die for damage, and discard the lowest result.
Temporal LeechEach target suffering more damage than its Willpower Bonus must make a Very Hard (-30) test with a Characteristic of its choice. For every Degree of Failure on the test, that creature suffers 1d10 Characteristic damage to that Characteristic. Dark Eldar may get Pain Tokens from this.
ToxicAnyone that takes Damage from a Toxic weapon after Armor and Toughness must make a Toughness test with a -5 penalty for every point of damage suffered. Failure results in an immediate 1d10I Damage, with no reduction, to the same location.
Toxic (X)*Anyone that takes Damage from a Toxic weapon after Armor and Toughness must make a Toughness test with a -10 penalty per X. Failure results in an immediate 1d10 damage of the same type, with no reduction, to the same location. Some weapons may have additional effects; see their profiles for more info.
Twin-LinkedA weapon with this gains a +20 bonus to hit when fired and uses twice as much ammo. In addition, the weapon may score one additional hit if the attack roll succeeds by two or more Degrees of Success. Lastly, reload time is doubled.
Twin-Linked [BC]When firing a weapon with this quality, the wielder must choose either a +10 bonus to hit, or an additional hit if they score at least one successful hit. Twice the weapon's RoF is always expended each shot.
Tyranid WeaponOnly works for creatures with the Tyranid trait. No weapon training or reloading required, and it never jams. Heavy Weapons with this quality do not require bracing unless noted otherwise.
UnbalancedWeapons with this quality suffer a -10 when used to parry.
Unbalanced*Weapons with this quality suffer a -10 when used to parry and may not be used to make Lightning Attacks.
UnreliableUnreliable weapons jam on a roll of 91 or higher on all firing modes.
UnstableWhen a weapon with this hits, on a 1 it inflicts half damage, on 2-9 it deals normal, and 10 it deals double.
UnwieldyWeapons with this quality cannot be used to parry.
Unwieldy*Weapons with this quality cannot be used to parry or make Lightning Attacks.
Vengeful (X)Triggers Righteous Fury if any damage die result is X or higher.
VolatileAutomatically confirm Righteous Fury on a roll of 10 for damage.
Warp WeaponThese weapons ignore all AP generated from Armor or Cover. Force Fields and specially warded armor work as normal.
Witch-EdgeOnly works for characters with the Secrets of the Seers talent. The weapon gains bonus damage equal to twice the character's Strength Bonus and Pen equal to his base Psy Rating.

Primary SystemsUnlike Support Systems and weapons, Primary Systems don't take up hard points and are hardwired into all battlesuits.
[Battlesuit]Once per round when the pilot would take Critical Damage, 80% chance of rolling on the armor's crit table (TCG 31) instead.
Blacksun Filtration SystemsContains built-in Blacksun Filter (see "Gear" tab).
Enhanced Motive SystemsThe pilot gains Auto-Stabilised, as well as the battlesuit's Strength and Size. If this system is disabled, the suit is immobilized.
Environmental SealThe armor is sealed and can maintain an adequate oxygen supply as long as it's powered.
Jet PackMake a +20 Pilot (Personal) test to fall safely or take a short jump; +0 to gain Flyer (12) for 1 minute.
Multi-TrackerThe pilot gains Two-Weapon Wielder (or, if he already has it, an additional +10 bonus to WS/BS while dual-wielding).
Support SystemsAcquired separately and installed on hard points. All Support Systems are Extremely Rare.
Advanced Targeting SystemThe pilot may make Called Shots as a Half Action.
Counterfire Defence SystemThe pilot may reroll failed BS tests while using Overwatch or Supporting Fire.
Drone Controller SystemContains built-in Drone Controller (see Gear tab).
Early Warning OverrideThe pilot may use Overwatch as a Reaction.
Positional Relay SystemContains built-in Positional Relay (see Gear tab).
Stimulant InjectorThe pilot may inject one drug per round; holds 6 doses. The default drug lets the user temporarily ignore one non-fatal Critical Effect.
Shield GeneratorCounts as a Force Field (rating 40).
Target Lock SystemContains built-in Target Lock (see Gear tab).
Vectored Retro-ThrustersThe pilot may Disengage as a Half Action.
Velocity TrackerIgnore BS penalties caused by the target’s movement.
Signature SystemsAcquired separately. All Signature Systems are Unique.
Command and Control NodeThe pilot may make a Tech-Use test to let allies within 20m reroll failed BS tests against [Perception bonus] targets for one round.
Failsafe DetonatorExplodes when the pilot dies (3d10+10E, Blast (20)). Living pilots can make a -20 Willpower test to set it off manually.
Multi-Spectrum Sensor SuiteThe pilot may make a Tech-Use test to let allies within 20m ignore [Per Bonus + Degrees of Success] APs from Cover.
Neuroweb System JammerThe pilot may make a -10 Tech-Use test to shut down [Degrees of Success + 1] powered devices. (Weapons gain Overheats instead.)
Repulsor Impact FieldAllows the pilot to damage and possibly knock back nearby enemies.
DeathwatchAll qualities for base power armor types (Mk I-VI, Mk VIII, Grey Knight) match the Mk VII profile unless specified otherwise. See text for full details.
Mk VII Power ArmorAll8(10)-180kg--DW1616-9 in Rites of Battle Standard Issue Armor table
Enhanced Strength: Grants +20 to Strength.
Auto-senses: Give Dark Sight, and Heightened Senses (Sight and Sound) that stacks with implants. Immune to photon flash and stun grenades. Called Shot only takes a Half Action. Only applies while wearing helmet.
Osmotic Gill Life Sustainer: With the helmet on, the armor is sealed and can maintain an adequate oxygen supply as long as it's powered.
Vox-Link: Serves as a standard vox-caster.
Bio-Monitor and Injectors: +10 to all tests resisting the Toxic Quality or similar. 6 doses of pain suppressant allow him to ignore the effects of critical damage for 1d10 rounds; if stunned, negate it in 1 round.
Magnetized Boots: Magboots in sole of boot. Can be switched on and off.
Nutrient Recycling: For every two weeks without a source of nourishment, make a Toughness test or suffer one level of Fatigue. Repeat every two weeks but one step harder each time until some sustenance is provided.
Recoil Suppression: Provides the ability to fire Basic weapons one-handed without penalty.
Giant Among Men: Increases size class to Hulking, increasing base move by 1. Black Carapace negates bonus to hit. Penalties to Concealment and Silent Move still apply.
Poor Manual Dexterity: -10 to any tests using equipment that is not sized for Astartes.

General Power Armor Sub-Systems
Auto-SensesGains Dark Sight and Heightened Senses (Sight, Sound) which stack with any existing Heightened Senses. Grants immunity to photon flash and stun grenades. May make Called Shots as a Half Action.
Osmotic Life Gill SustainerWith the helmet on, the armor is sealed and can maintain an adequate oxygen supply as long as it's powered.
Vox LinkMay be used to communicate, as well as transfer data from bio-monitors (if installed) to other vox-links.
Magnetised Boot SolesAllows the wearer to stick to metal. Reduce Agility by half when in use, but may otherwise move normally in low or zero-gravity areas.
Sustainable Power SourceAn everlasting power supply.
Legion Power Armor Sub-Systems
Enhanced Ceramite PlatingHas AP 10 on body instead of 8.
Bio-Monitor and Injectors+10 to all tests resisting the Toxic Quality or similar. 6 doses of pain suppressant allow him to ignore characteristic damage or penalties caused by critical damage for 1d10 rounds; if stunned, negate it in 1 round.
Nutrient RecyclingFor every two weeks without a source of nourishment, make a -10 Toughness test or suffer one level of Fatigue. Repeat every two weeks but one step harder each time until some sustenance is provided.
Recoil SuppressionProvides the ability to fire Basic weapons one-handed without penalty.
Power Armor Customization
1 - Scavenged Reconstruction+10 to Infamy, Intimidate and Command against any Space Marine. Legion only.
2 - Power Supply TamperingThe armor can power certain weapons indefinitely. Quick Draw doesn't apply to the weapon.
3 - HornsThe wearer's Charge attacks can't be Parried.
4 - SpikesUnarmed attackers take 1d5 Damage per Degree of Failure on their WS test.
5 - Careful MaintenanceChoose two additional sub-systems.
6 - Chain BandoliersMay destroy any melee weapon that hits the Body (as per Power Weapons).
7 - Chain Loinguard-2 to Critical Damage effects against the legs.
8 - Devotional IconographyHelps command Daemons and followers of one Chaos God, penalties against Opposed alignments.
9 - Remnants of MutationThe wearer's next mutation is determined by picking from a specific list instead of rolling.
10 - Black Legion Armour+1 AP for Unaligned wearers. Legion only.

Templates

Templates
Random Artefacts (SOI 85)
After determining the base item (see text), roll again for the following as needed: Origin, special abilities, Quirks, and Craftsmanship.
Origins
1-3: Finely Wrought1 Quirk, automatically Best Craftsmanship. No other benefits.
4-6: Archeotech2 Quirks, +3 to Craftsmanship roll, requires Forbidden Lore (Archeotech) Test before attempting repairs.
1 - 2ImposingWeapon: +10 to Intimidate and Command. Users with Fear (X) increase X by 1.
Armour: +10 to Intimidate and Command, and grants the Air of Authority talent.
Gear/Tool: +20 to all Opposed Tests against an opponent that can see the item.
Ship Component: +10 to Intimidate and Command.
3 - 4CompactWeapon: 1/2 weight, -20 on Search Tests to find the weapon when concealed.
Armour: 1/2 weight, -10 on Awareness Tests to notice the armour (-20 if covered).
Gear/Tool: 1/2 weight, -30 on Search Tests to find the item when concealed.
Ship Component: Space requirement -4 (minimum 1 if Internal or 0 if External).
5SteadyMelee: If Balanced/Unbalanced/Unwieldy, +3 Pen; otherwise, gains Balanced.
Ranged: If Accurate/Flame/Scatter, gains Reliable and +2 Pen; otherwise, gains Accurate.
Armour: +10 to Climb and Acrobatics.
Gear/Tool: Reroll one failed Test per session.

Daemonic Mastery
ModifierMasteryOpposed Willpower test; modifiers stack up to +60/-60. This table also applies to summoning, rituals, et cetera.
+5 per Psy Rating*The character is a psyker.
30The character knows the daemon’s True Name.
The character has the Mark of the daemon’s patron god.
The character is a Dark Apostle of the daemon's alignment.
The character has Dark Patronage from a god or daemon of the daemon's aligment.
20“The Stars are Right” - auspicious circumstances.
The character has sworn allegiance to the daemon’s master or cause, or is Devoted to the daemon’s patron god.
*The character is a psyker with Psy Rating >= 7.
The veil between reality and the Warp has been greatly weakened.
Sacred Numbers are used correctly as part of the ritual (TOE 57).
10Ritual follows the “Rule of Sympathy.”
The daemon has been provided with a suitable sacrifice to partake of upon its arrival.
The character has an Aethéme Blade or Rituals Kit.
The character has an artefact connected to the daemon.
*The character is a psyker with a Psy Rating between 4 and 6.
The veil between reality and the Warp has been weakened.
The character knows part of the Daemon’s True Name.
0The character knows the daemon’s allegiance and kind.
-10The character knows little of what is being called up.
The veil between reality and the Warp is strong.
The ritual is being conducted on hallowed/sanctified ground, or powerful Imperial Cult believers are present.
-20The character has sworn allegiance to an unrelated master or cause, or is Devoted to an opposed god.
The ritual is taking place within an active Gellar Field.
The character only knows the steps to most of the ritual.
The ritual involves Sacred Numbers that are used incorrectly, or are associated with an opposed Chaos God.
-30The character knows nothing of what he is doing, or is unwilling.
The character recently summoned or commanded daemons of an opposing allegiance.
The character only knows part of the ritual, or some of the information he has about the ritual is inaccurate or just false.
The character is an amateur with no true appreciation for what it is they are attempting to do.
The character is a Dark Apostle of a different alignment.
The character has gained Dark Patronage from a Chaos God or Daemon aligned in opposition with the ritual that is to be attempted.

Vehicle Key

Vehicle Key
Refer to the vehicle's sourcebook and corresponding core rulebook for full rules.
For reference, one AU (Aerial Unit) is equal to 100 meters. If a conversion is needed, simply divide it by 100 and round up to the next whole number.
It is advised that you read the full description of the source material of any interesting item for a better understanding of what it is. This document is only a quick reference.
Keyword Reference
AmphibiousThis vehicle functions on water as if it were open ground.
Anti-Air (Rudimentary)Halve the standard penalties for attacking aircraft.
Anti-Air (Advanced)Ignore the standard penalties for attacking aircraft.
Anti-Grav EnginesThe vehicle may count as a Skimmer (and follows all the rules for a Skimmer) for up to 10 minutes before it must return to counting as a Flyer. It may do this once every hour.
AquaticOnly functions in water.
Attack BikeThe Bike can be upgraded to an Attack Bike. This allows the bike to carry one passenger, and give the bike a passenger-operated Astartes Heavy Bolter or Astartes Multi-Melta with a facing to the front and right. The bike's size increases one step, its Maneuverability decreases to +12, and it requires Respected Renown.
BladevanesWhen attempting a Ram Action against a creature, the vehicle deals 1d10+5R Damage, Pen 4, or 2d10+5R Damage if travelling at least twice its tactical speed. It may continue to move, after hitting. The pilot may choose to take an additional -20 penalty on the Drive (Skimmers) test to choose the location struck.
BikeBikes are always considered Open-Topped, and anyone within melee range can attack the rider without a Called Shot. Bikes can use the Hit & Run action (OW 273) but they can't make Ram attacks.
BomberThis vehicle's payload is anti-ship weapons, and may only be used to target ships or similarly large emplacements. If used on a vehicle or individual, it is likely they would be utterly annihilated.
Bred for WarThe mount automatically passes all Willpower tests caused by the Bestial trait.
Bullet SprayThe driver of this vehicle gains the Auto-Stabilised trait for firing this vehicle's weapons. If this vehicle is moved in the same turn that it fired, it does not gain the usual bonus to hit for full-auto fire.
Breaching Vehicle (X) {Y}This vehicle is designed to forcibly board enemy starships. It takes X full rounds to burn through the hull. If Y is present, the pilot must test to attach to the side of a vessel with a +Y Pilot (Spacecraft) test.
Ceramite ArmorThis vehicle is equipped with heat-resistant ceramite armor for atmospheric re-entry. Any melta weapon count their Penetration as 0 against this vehicle.
Chariot of IrePassengers may make melee attacks against targets adjacent to the vehicle. If the vehicle takes a Movement Action, this can be performed as a Charge (gaining the effect of the Berserk Charge talent and Brutal Charge trait) against any targets within reach of the vehicle's path.
Combat WalkerA walker always has a Basic Melee Attack (representing the ability to charge, batter, and smash targets): Melee, 1d10I+SB, Pen 0, Unwieldy
Command and ControlThe special feature of this vehicle allows a character using it to use his Command skill to affect a number of squads, units, or other teams equal to his Fellowship bonus. This effect combines with Fellowship-based Talents such as Iron Discipline, Master Orator, and the like. Any character using this equipment also gains a +10 bonus to Command Skill tests.
Daemon EngineThis vehicle either removes 1 Critical Damage or repairs 1d5 Structural Integrity each round, and has a Force Field (Protection Rating 30, never overloads) that can be bypassed by Sanctified/Force attacks or damaging psychic powers.
DaemonicThe vehicle functions as a Daemon Weapon; see the Templates tab for special quality descriptions. The daemon can be subdued with the Ritual of Breaking (TOF 66).
Daemonic PossessionThe vehicle may fire all of its weapons as part of the same Half Action each turn, and may do so even if in melee (though it must do so at different targets than those it is engaged with). If in melee, it may spend an additional Half Action to make one attack. The vehicle counts as having the Lightning Attack Talent. None can ride within the vehicle. Finally, ignore Jarring Blow and Staggered Critical Hits, as well as any that may specifically target a pilot.
Daemonic Possession*This vehicle has no crew, ignores any effects that would damage crew members, and can use all of its weapons in a single attack as if each weapon had its own gunner.
Damage ControlAny Righteous Fury result against this vehicle may be rerolled, but the reroll is final. Extinguishing vehicle fires is a Free Action.
Decoy LaunchersSophisticated electronic decoys combined with flares and chaff launchers make this vehicle harder to target. At any point during the pilot's turn, he may activate the decoy launchers as a Free Action. Until the beginning of his next turn, any shooting receives no bonus due to size to hit. May be used three times before needing replacement.
Dirge CasterAll followers of Chaos within 100 meters gain the Fearless Talent.
DreadnoughtUses special rules detailed in the appropriate section. Page 180 for Adeptus Astartes Dreadnoughts, and page 190 for Chaos Space Marine Dreadnoughts.
Drone RacksThe vehicle does not need to land in order to deploy its drones. It has three drone racks, with a total of 14 drones it may deploy (see DW 367 for Tau gun drones).
DronesCarries two Gun Drones (DW 367) attached to the front. They may fire their weapons using their normal BS in addition to the vehicle's weapons.
Dreadclaw AssaultDreadclaws are somewhat unique amongst vehicles, in that once they "land," they do not move under their own power. Must be launched from a starship with drop pod bays and travel directly downward towards the target planet until they hit the ground. Cannot maneuver, though provided that they are 500km above the ground, may change in flight location to any within 25km of original target. All shooting at the pod suffers a -30 while in flight. When landing, pick your destination then scatter 2d10 meters. Once landed, the Dreadclaw may take off and operate as a skimmer, even exiting the atmosphere to return to space. It may behave like an Assault Boat in the void.
Drop Pod AssaultDrop pods are somewhat unique amongst vehicles, in that once they "land," they do not move under their own power. Must be launched from a starship with drop pod bays and travel directly downward towards the target planet until they hit the ground. Cannot maneuver, though provided that they are 500km above the ground, may change in flight location to any within 25km of original target. All shooting at the pod suffers a -30 while in flight. When landing, pick your destination then scatter 2d10 meters.
EnclosedCrew members and passengers can't make attacks with their personal weapons (unless the vehicle has firing slits) and can't be targeted by typical attacks.
Enhanced Auspex ArraysThis vehicle has powerful auspex arrays to aid in combat. The crew of this vehicle suffers no penalties for darkness, foul weather, or other effects that would normally obscure vision. In addition, they gain a +20 to all Awareness tests, and may make Awareness tests at ranges of up to 5km (at GM's discretion, may be farther for a particularly large target).
Enhanced Motive Systems This vehicle can move double its Tactical Speed as a Half Action, or triple that as a Full Action. The Floor It action covers at least triple the vehicle's Tactical Speed and requires an Operate test at +10 rather than -10. If the vehicle also has Ponderous, the two traits cancel out and the vehicle uses the normal rules for movement.
Environmentally SealedProtects passengers from toxic gas and other environmental effects. If the seal is breached by Critical Damage, the vehicle must be repaired for the seal to function again.
Escape PodIf the vehicle is destroyed, the pilots may eject. The pod scatters like a missed grenade a total of 2d10 meters from the point at which the vehicle was destroyed, or the wreckage at GM's discretion. The Pilot and Co-pilot are equipped with a micro-bead and a pulse pistol (or other appropriate side-arm for non-Tau escape pods). See ROB 197 for Tau pilot profile.
ExposedEnemies may target the crew and passengers of the vehicle by using a Called Shot Attack Action. If someone makes a Full Automatic Attack Action against the vehicle, every third hit is resolved against the rider (or passengers, if any) instead of the vehicle.
Extremely VolatileDoubles the chance of exploding when the vehicle catches fire, and may ignite anyone caught in its blast radius (-10 Agility test to avoid).
Feral Machine SpiritAll shooting against this vehicle suffers a -10 penalty as long as it is mobile. This does not stack with Dreadclaw Assault or Drop Pod Assault.
FlickerfieldThe vehicle’s size does not grant attackers any bonus to hit, nor does it impose any penalties upon the pilot’s attempts to Dodge. No attacker may gain a bonus to hit from aiming at a vehicle with a flickerfield.
Frag Assault LaunchersThis vehicle is armed with Frag Assault Launchers, single-shot scatter grenades employed to cover the vehicle's final assault (Facing Front, Range 10m, 2d10X, Pen 0, Clip 1). Frag launchers may be fired as a Free Action, and fire in a 45 degree cone from the vehicle, hitting everything within range. When they fire, they force automatic Pinning tests from all eligible targets within range.
FlyerThis aircraft uses aerodynamic principles to stay aloft. When airborne, it must move at least half its cruising speed at all times lest it crash to the ground. If it ever becomes completely immobilized due to damage, count the vehicle as destroyed instead as it crashes to the ground.
Flyer [DH2]The vehicle must move at least its Tactical Speed each turn, or else lose altitude and risk crashing (DH2 256). When the vehicle is at Low or Hovering altitude, attacks against it take an additional -20 penalty; at higher altitudes, the vehicle can't be attacked at all (except by specialized anti-air weapons).
Gang WheelsThe Hectin Autocarriage can be acquired as Open-Topped instead of Enclosed, which increases Carrying Capacity to 8 and allows the addition of a Pintle mount (compatible with any Basic weapon).
Ground VehicleThis vehicle follows all rules for ground vehicles.
HolofieldAll shooting attacks against a moving vehicle with this special rule suffer a -20 to hit.
ImmobileImmobile vehicles are incapable of moving under their own power, and usually aren't susceptible to Critical Damage results against their Motive Systems.
Improved Command and ControlThe special feature of this vehicle allows a character using it to use his Command skill to affect a number of squads, units, or other teams equal to his Fellowship bonus. This effect combines with Fellowship-based Talents such as Iron Discipline, Master Orator, and the like. Any character using this equipment also gains a +20 to Command Skill tests and may reroll any failed Command Skill tests.
Improvised WeaponsWhen used against Average sized targets or smaller, all of the vehicle's weapons suffer a -30 to hit. All weapons may be used by any crew.
Inferno Gun - Titanic Flame WeaponWhen firing, pick any point within the weapon's range as the point of origin. The spray extends 40 meters past that point, following normal Flame rules.
InsanityThe mind of the pilot is twisted and warped. If not engaged in melee, at the beginning of each turn, the pilot must make a Willpower test. If successful, fight as normal. If failed by three degrees or less, do not move, but fire all weapons at the closest enemy target, gaining a +10 to all Ballistic Skill tests. If there are no enemy targets, fire at the nearest friendly target. If there are no targets in range, spitefully destroy vegetation and buildings. If failed by three or more degrees, it is caught in bloodlust and madness. It may not fire any weapon. Instead, double move rate and make 1d5+2 melee attacks in close combat, instead of its normal amount.
Integral WeaponThis vehicle's guns always count as Braced, can be fired as a Half Action, and can be used untrained with no penalties.
Jamming BeaconAuspexes, locator beacons, teleport homers, and similar wargear does not function within 15 meters of this vehicle. The etheric interference caused by a Jamming Beacon also interferes with other forms of teleportation, such as daemonic summoning.
Kustom BitzPick one: Armor Plates (Facing Any, +3 AP to assigned facing); Red Paint Job (At the start of each Round, roll 1d10, adding the result to the vehicle's tactical movement).
LegionCan only be operated by Chaos Space Marines.
Life Support (Hephaestus)A fully outfitted vehicles contains enough air, fuel, water, and provisions for a full complement of crew and passengers to survive in relative comfort for a month in hostile environments.
Life Support (Venator)When operating in a toxic or extreme environment, the exposed sections of the vehicle can be sealed with thick transparent plates to protect the passengers. This feature does not negate Open-Topped.
Linked Pilot-Operated WeaponryWeapons classified as pilot-operated may all be fired as one standard action at targets within 1 AU (100m) of each other.
LivingThe vehicle is also a creature, which may affect certain Critical Damage results. Riders must be at least one size smaller than the vehicle unless otherwise specified. All tests to control the vehicle use the Survival skill (DH2 116) instead of Operate. See text for full creature stats.
Living MetalHalve all Critical Hit rolls against the vehicle (round up). The vehicle repairs one point of Critical Damage per round, negating the critical effect inflicted by that damage.
Long Range Augur ArrayThese sophisticated augurs provide a detailed view of the land below, granting the operators +20 to all Awareness and Scrutiny tests, and allowing scans in the same manner as an Auspex up to 50km away.
Mastery of GravityAt any time, the vehicle may operate as a skimmer rather than a flyer.
More DakkaInstead of firing its weapons separately, the operator may fire all of the same type simultaneously, combining their damage.
MountA personal-scale vehicle, usually only slightly larger than its rider. See text (TOB 47 / TOE 44) for full rules.
Open-ToppedPassengers/crew can make attacks with personal weapons, and can be attacked with the Called Shot action. Blast and Spray attacks aimed at the vehicle also affect everyone inside.
Orbital DeploymentThe pilot chooses a location on the battlefield, and the vehicle lands 2d10 metres away from that point in a random direction. Anyone attempting to attack the vehicle while it deploys takes a -30 penalty to hit. The vehicle can move during the next round (if capable), but passengers must wait a full round after landing before firing any weapons or leaving the vehicle.
(Co-)Pilot-Operated Linked WeaponryAll weapons classified as "(Co-)Pilot-Operated" may all be fired by the pilot as one shooting action, at targets no more than one AU apart. Roll for hits and damage separately with each weapon.
PonderousThis vehicle can't take the Floor It action and must take a Full Action to move its listed Tactical Speed. If the vehicle also has Enhanced Motive Systems, the two traits cancel out and the vehicle uses the normal rules for movement.
Power of the Machine SpiritThe vehicle is equipped with a complex core-cogitator that is blessed with an unusually cunning Machine Spirit. When firing the vehicle's weapons, the vehicle commander may fire one additional weapon system. That weapon's firing is directed by the pilot character, but uses the Machine Spirit's BS of 50. The attack does not benefit from any Talents or other attributes the pilot possesses (in effect, it is being fired by the Machine Spirit).
Power OverloadIf four or more results of 90-100 are rolled when firing the vehicle's weapons, the vehicle automatically generates one roll on the vehicle critical hit chart against itself, unmodified by the Reinforced Hull rule.
Precarious MountEvery third shot from Fully Automatic fire hits a passenger instead of the vehicle. Passengers may test Acrobatics to dismount as a Free Action.
Predator AuspexSophisticated onboard radar, sonar, and thermal augur arrays, combined with sensitive chem-sniffers, allow a crew to track prey with unerring accuracy over vast distances. The Predator Auspex counts as an Auspex with a range of 500 meters that also grants a +20 to Tracking tests made to search for, track, and identify prey.
Quantum ShieldingProvides an additional 10 AP to the vehicle and all crew/passengers. The field dissipates if the vehicle takes a Critical Hit or Righteous Fury.
RamshackleRighteous Fury rolls against this vehicle use 1d10 rather than 1d5, and the vehicle suffers twice the rolled damage when it uses the Ram action against a solid target. The vehicle grants a +20 bonus on tests to Repair it, takes half as long as usual to repair, and always counts as Lightly Damaged (unless it's taken Critical Damage).
ReinforcedReduce all damage to the vehicle by 1. Mounts used by Chaos Space Marines must be Reinforced.
Reinforced ArmourHalve all Critical Damage results (round up). Doesn't apply to Righteous Fury.
Reinforced HullWhen a vehicles with a Reinforced Hull receives a Critical Hit, halve the result, rounding up. This quality does not affect rolls on the Critical Hit charge generated by Righteous Fury.
ReliableAny Tech-Use test made to repair or restore this vehicle receives a +20 bonus.
Rugged+20 to all Repair tests.
SentryThe vehicle's weapons can be configured to attack on their own, and can be set to either Point Defence mode (counts as an Overwatch action with a 90-degree arc) or Sentry mode (the vehicle rolls Initiative and can attack at up to 1/2 its weapon's range during its turn). See text for details on changing modes and target selection.
Sidecar (X)Increase the vehicle's Structural Integrity by X (already included in stats) and apply a -10 penalty to all riding tests. Passengers act immediately after the rider's Initiative.
Siege ShieldDrive tests for Difficult Terrain gain a +10 bonus, and any failed Drive tests for Difficult Terrain may be rerolled.
SkimmerThis vehicle hovers over the battlefield, allowing it to ignore terrain that might otherwise hamper movement. If it ever becomes completely immobilized due to damage, count the vehicle as destroyed instead as it crashes into the ground.
Skimmer [OW]Skimmers move similarly to a creature with the Hoverer trait, but they ignore Difficult Terrain and can also fly at Low Altitude (OW 38, DH2 249). They also gain a +10 bonus on Manoeuvrability tests, may Crash if immobilized or when failing a Ram attack (OW 280. DH2 256), and may turn freely when moving at any speed. Melee attacks against a skimmer take a -10 penalty to hit.
SpacecraftThis vehicle may exit the atmosphere. While in the atmosphere it may operate as a skimmer or flyer at the pilot's choice. It gains all the benefits and drawbacks of skimmers and flyers.
Speed BoosterThe driver may take a Half Action to change the vehicle’s Cruising Speed / Tactical Speed / Manoeuvrability to 120kph / 15m / -20 for the next six rounds. Requires 1 hour to recharge after use.
Stealth Field GeneratorThe vehicle has a Stealth Field. It operates in two modes: Active or Passive. It may be changed as a Free Action from one turn to the next. In Passive Mode, all tests of any sort to detect and any BS tests to hit suffer a -10 (senses other than sight are unaffected). In Active Mode, any sort of test to detect the vehicle and all WS and BS tests suffer a -30 (this applies to all senses, including augmented ones). Anyone attempting to locate the vehicle may attempt an Awareness test using the above mods. Passing this by one or more degrees will alert the character that his sensors are being interfered with, but not its effects.
Super-HeavyThis vehicle ignores all penalties for difficult terrain and gains the Ponderous trait. A Walker with this trait can choose to walk over anything less than 5 metres high, or it can just ignore any obstacles weaker than itself and smash through them unhindered.
Super-Heavy WalkerWalkers are able to ignore penalties for moving through difficult terrain, and negotiate obstacles such as rock slides, tank traps, fallen trees, and shattered buildings without penalty. This walker is particularly large and powerful. It is 14 meters tall and can walk over obstacles 5 meters high, or simply bulldoze through walls, forests, or medium-sized buildings without suffering negative effects.
Supremely ManeuverableWhen increasing the distance of a turn in space, the Piloting test is always +0, no matter how extreme the turn. In addition, may turn after moving 3 AU's rather than 4.
Targeter ArrayThe driver of this vehicle gains the Auto-Stabilised trait for firing this vehicle's weapons.
Targeting ArrayThe vehicle is equipped with a sophisticated guidance system that give the pilot +20 BS when firing the vehicle's weaponry.
Terrain Master+10 on all movement tests incurred due to rough terrain.
Titanic Critical HitsThis vehicle is so large as to require its own Critical Hit Chart. Warhound Titans have theirs on page 188 of Rites of Battle.
Tracked VehicleTracked Vehicles take a -10 penalty to all Manoeuvrability tests, but gain a +10 bonus to all tests involving Difficult Terrain. All Tactical Speed penalties caused by Critical Damage to the Motive Systems are halved (round down), but repairing the damaged Motive Systems takes twice as long as normal.
UnrulyWhenever this mount takes damage, it attempts to throw its rider off. If successful, it may either attack the rider or try to escape.
Vector Thrust EnginesThe aircraft may count as a Skimmer (and follows all the rules for a Skimmer) for up to 2 minutes before it must return to counting as a Flyer. It may do this once every hour.
Void ShieldsVoid shields are near impenetrable barriers. They count as a barrier with 25 AP that surrounds the vehicle in all directions at a 5 meter distance. To disable a void shield, attacks must deal 20 damage past 25 AP (this damage is cumulative, but penetration has no effect on a void shield). Attacks from within the 5 meter projection distance ignore the void shield and directly affect the vehicle. Once a shield is brought down, it may be restored with a successful -10 Tech-Use test. A success means it will be restored in 1d5+5 rounds, -1 round per Degree of Success, to a minimum of 1 Round.
Vulcan Mega-Bolter - Area SaturationWhen used in this manner, designate a 20x20 meter area. Make one Ballistic Skill test against each target in this area - any success means a target takes one hit, which can be Dodged as normal.
WalkerWalkers are able to ignore penalties for moving through difficult terrain, and negotiate obstacles such as rock slides, tank traps, fallen trees, and shattered buildings without penalty.
Walker [OW]Walkers ignore most types of Difficult Terrain, may turn freely when moving at any speed, and can turn to face a melee opponent at the end of its turn as a Free Action. Walkers can't Ram targets, but they can make a Charge attack instead.
Wheeled VehicleWheeled Vehicles gain a +10 bonus to all Manoeuvrability tests, but take a -20 penalty to all tests involving Difficult Terrain. If the vehicle takes Critical Damage to the Motive Systems, any kind of movement requires an Operate test and all Manoeuvrability tests take a -10 penalty. Fortunately, repairing the damaged Motive Systems only takes half as long as normal.

Ablative Armour+4 Armour (All), -5 to the vehicle's Tactical Speed/Cruising Speed, -10 Manoeuvrability. Any Critical Damage to a location with ablative armour irreparably destroys the armour on that location, but causes no Critical Effects.Standard-10SOH132Any.
Anti-Grenade MeshWhenever this vehicle is hit by a grenade, roll 1d10. 7+: the grenade scatters 1d5m away before exploding. 1: the Anti-Grenade Mesh is damaged by the explosion. Anyone trying to set placed explosives (e.g. melta bombs) on the vehicle takes a -20 penalty on any relevant tests.Standard10SOH132Any.
Artificer Hull+10 to Jink tests, -20 to Repair tests, and all incoming Critical Damage is reduced by 4. The vehicle takes no damage when it performs a Ram action.Integral-40SOH132Any.
Camo-NettingRequires no test to install, and imposes a -30 penalty on attempts to see the vehicle (as long as it isn't moving or firing). May be damaged if the vehicle catches fire.Standard+20*SOH132Any.

Ship Key

Ships and Components
Contains all ship hulls and components from Rogue Trader. Using Rogue Trader Errata 1.4.
It is advised that you read the full description of the source material of any interesting item for a better understanding of what it is. This document is only a quick reference.
Keyword Reference
Additional Plasma Conduits (X)The vessel has many heavy plasma conduits. Increase power generated by X. However, with every Critical Hit suffered, there is a 25% chance of the Fire! Critical Hit as well.
Advanced Cogitator LinkageGain +5 to fire the ship's weaponry.
Ancient Grand CruiserMay not gain any components that increase armor.
Antiquated CommunicationsAll Command tests made on a vessel with this quality suffer a -5 penalty.
Battlecruiser/Grand CruiserMay mount "Cruiser Only" components.
Beam Dispersion EffectWhen firing at targets over 20 VU's away, decrease damage to 1d10.
BroadsideMust be equipped in a port or starboard slot.
Cargo Hauler/Galleon (X)Vessel designed for transporting goods. Hull comes pre-equipped with X Main Cargo Hold Component(s). Space has already been reduced to account for this, however, when the ship is constructed it must be able to provide Power for each Component.
Carrier (X)Comes pre-equipped with X number of Jovian-class Landing Bay Components, which occupy an equally distributed number of Port and Starboard weapon capacity slots. They may not be removed. Enough power must be supplied for them, but Space is already accounted for.
Core ArchitectureThis component is always revealed with Active Augury.
CrampedThe ship is very cramped, and there is little room for supplies. May only stock three months worth of supplies instead of six, before including any components that add to this.
CursedAll Navigation tests carried out by the Navigator suffer a -10.
Death from AboveMay only be mounted in Prow, Dorsal, or Keel slots. When in orbit, gain +20 to Intimidate ground targets. Gain 50 Achievement points if used in a Military Objective against the planet. When used as part of a planetary bombardment, double the affected area, add 20 to the damage done to large units, and 10 to individuals and vehicles.
DestructiveIf this weapon generates a Critical Hit, add 1 to the result.
Easy to Repair (X)When making Long-Term Repairs, increase the amount by X for a successful test.
Enhanced Magnetic CoilsTorpedoes launched from this tube gain +2 Speed for their first turn. They return to normal after this.
Energy FieldThe security hatches must be open during the Strategic Turn it is used. If this Component loses power while they are open, it becomes Depressurized as well.
ExternalComponent doesn't require any hull space. Can only be destroyed or damaged by a Critical Hit.
Fast ShipDue to the ship's carefully balanced nature, it cannot have Components that increase its Armor.
Fiery Temperament (X)Any plasma drive installed on a vessel with this trait increases its output by X.
Heavy WeaponMay only be mounted in a Prow Weapon Slot unless the ship is a Grand Cruiser or larger, in which case it may be mounted in a Dorsal Slot as well. In Prow slots, it may only fire forward.
Hybrid VesselMay be equipped with Transport or Cruiser Components. If a Component exists in both varieties, the Cruiser variant must be chosen.
Ionic BlastNever causes Critical Hits, nor do they deal damage to Hull Integrity. May only be combined in a salvo with weapons that share this quality.
InfernoWhenever this weapon inflicts a Critical Hit, it is automatically Fire! Critical.
Inherent Warship (X)This ship comes pre-equipped with certain components which may not be removed, specified in the parenthesis. Space will have been accounted for, but power must be supplied.
Jury-RiggedReduce the speed of Attack Craft exiting the bay by 2 on the turn they are launched. Any craft attempting to land in combat must make a test to land safely. Outside of combat, it simply takes half an hour per squadron.
Labor IntensiveWeapon may only be fired every other turn.
Overheating SystemsFor every five Degrees of Failure when firing, the vessel suffers a Critical Hit. If a specific Component is affected, it's automatically this Component.
Oversized MonstrosityThis vessel's conventional Speed may not be increased by any component. If it would be, simply ignore the effect.
Penetrator Rounds (X)Ignore X armor when calculating damage done in a salvo involving this weapon.
Plasma RefineryThis vessel comes pre-equipped with a unique component, the Plasma Refinery. The use of this component is detailed on page 30 of Battlefleet Koronus.
Powered by the StarsProvided a vessel equipped with a Plasma Refinery harvests from a star once a year, it gains +10 power.
Reliable Construction (X)If this component becomes damaged, depressurized, or suffers a Critical Hit (including a 4 or 6 result on the chart), roll 1d10. On X or greater, it is ignored.
RetrofitMay be used to replace a Main Cargo Hold on a transport. Only one may be used, and it does not take a Weapon Capacity slot.
Secondary Power GenetoriumThis vessel comes pre-equipped with a unique component, a Secondary Power Genetorium. Space has already been accounted for, and it provides +10 power to the primary reactor.
Self Propelled WarheadBefore firing this weapon, the option is available to increase Range by 2, but decrease damage to 1d10+1.
Short the FlowFor every five damage inflicted that exceeds the target's Void Shields, one randomly selected Component on the target ship becomes Unpowered. This ignores Armor.
Small WeaponMay be installed on Dorsal and Keel Weapon Slots on vessels of frigate sized or smaller.
Structural ImpactReduce Hull Integrity and Maneuverability permanently by 5.
Terminal Penetration (X)Reroll damage dice less than or equal to X. The reroll stands.
Torpedo Specialist {X}A Prow slot is occupied by a Voss-Pattern Torpedo Tube Component that may not be removed. Space is already taken into account, but power must be provided. If X is included, multiply the munitions storage by this value to determine maximum number of torpedoes.
VaporizationWhen this Weapon rolls a 1 or 2 on the Critical Hit Chart, it affects two components instead of one
VersatileGain +5 to the opposed Command test made to resolve boarding actions.
VolatileIf this Component is Damaged or Destroyed while Torpedoes are loaded in its tubes, there is a 10% chance of it exploding. If this occurs, the Component is automatically destroyed and the ship suffers 2d5 damage directly to Hull Integrity.

Complications

Complications
Based on Rogue Trader's tables 8-1 (RT 197) and 8-2 (RT 198), and the Background Packages from ITS 153-155.
Machine Spirit Oddities (RT 8-1)
RollResultDetails
1A Nose for TroubleAdd +5 to the ship's Detection, and reduce its Armor by 1. Occasionally, the crew may find themselves in fights they might have preferred to avoid.
2Blasphemous TendenciesAll Navigation tests made to pilot this vessel through the warp gain a +15 bonus. However, while aboard the ship, all crew suffer -5 to Willpower-based tests.
3Martial HubrisThe ship gains +5 to all Ballistic Skill tests to fire its weapons, but suffers -15 on any Pilot (Space Craft) tests made to escape combat.
4RebelliousDuring no more than one space combat per game session, the GM should randomly select one of the ship's Components that becomes unpowered until repaired. However, when the ship suffers a critical hit roll 1d10. On 8+, the effect is ignored.
5StoicWhenever the crew would gain PF from an Endeavor, reduce the amount gained by 1. However, whenever one of the ship's Components becomes damaged or unpowered, roll 1d10. On 7+, the ship shrugs off the damage and it is ignored.
6SkittishWhen in combat, reduce the ship's Speed by 1. Reduce the travel time for any long distance (interstellar) voyage by 1d5 weeks, to a minimum of 1.
7WrothfulDuring combat, the ship gains +1 Speed and +7 Maneuverability. Out of combat, the ship suffers -1 Speed and -5 Maneuverability and Detection.
8ResoluteThe ship suffers -1 Speed, but gains +3 Hull Points and grants a +10 bonus to all Repair tests.
9AdventurousWhen participating in an Endeavor the ship gains +10 Detection. When not, it suffers -10 Detection.
10Ancient and WiseThe ship suffers -4 Hull Integrity, but gains a +10 bonus to any Maneuver action it performs (including out of combat and ramming).
Past Histories (RT 8-2)
RollResultDetails
1Reliquary of MarsWhen constructing this vessel, players must select 1 Archeotech Component of their choice. However, any Tech-Use to repair the ship suffer a -20.
2HauntedReduce Morale permanently by 10. However, strange premonitions flicker on the augur arrays, granting a +6 to the ship's Detection. All non-crewmembers suffer -5 to Command tests involving boarding actions or hit and run actions against the haunted vessel.
3Emissary of the ImperatorAll Intimidate tests made by characters from this vessel gain +15 while other social skill tests suffer -5. These bonuses and penalties only apply if the character is known to be from the vessel. In addition, few will be able to see beyond the symbolism of the vessel.
4Wolf in Sheep's ClothingThe Captain selects 3 components. When scanned or subjected to anything but a thorough internal inspection, these components will not register on the scans, or appear to be a different Component of the same type. Suffer -2 Power to maintain this illusion. May have other secrets hidden aboard.
5Turbulent PastThe GM selects a social group. All ship's crew suffer a -20 to social skill tests when interacting with that group. The GM then selects a naturally opposed group to the first. All ship's crew gain +20 to social skills when interacting with THAT group.
6Death CultReduce Crew Population permanently by 8. However, reduce all Morale loss from any source by 2, due to the crew's unwwavering faith.
7Wrested from a Space HulkThe ship gains +1 Armor, Speed, and +3 Maneuverability. However, every time the crew suffers a Misfortune, the GM rolls twice and chooses the worse of the two.
8Temperamental Warp EngineWhenever the ship travels through the Immaterium, the GM should roll 1d10. On a 6 or less, the journey takes an additional 1d5 weeks. On 7+, the time is reduced by 1d5 weeks, potentially arriving before they left. Will occasionally end up somewhere that is not the intended destination.
9Finances in ArrearsWhenever the crew attempts to complete an Endeavor's Objective, they must accumulate an additional 50 Achievement Points to accomplish the Objective. However, the financier supports his investment by providing aid and information. All crew count their financier as a reliable contact. They may provide specific missions.
10XenophilousWhen constructing this vessel, players must select 1 Xenotech Component of their choice. However, any Tech-Use tests to repair the ship suffer a -30. Should the character attempting the repairs have Forbidden Lore (Xenos), the penalty is only -10.
Purchasable Background Packages
CostNameClassDetails
1Thulian Explorator VesselFrigates, Light Cruisers, CruisersAdd +10 to the ship's Detection and +50 to Exploration Achievement Points. Must be equipped with one Archeotech Component. Reduce Speed by 1 and Maneuverability by 5.

Changelog

Changelog
1.12.0.0, 4/6/11Changelog finally begun! Battlefleet Koronus added in this version, as well as numerous typo fixes.
1.12.1.0, 4/7/11Updated the Voidsunder Lance Battery, Jovian-Pattern Nova Cannon, Plasma Accelerated Torpedo Tubes, Bombardment Cannons with their soon-to-be errata values, and added the Mezoa-Pattern Theta-7 Drive as per the forums, and a couple other fixes that FFG Devs have said will be in Errata. Will release a 1.12.2.0 when official Errata is out. Also added Torpedo Guidance Systems under the Ship Upgrades tab, as it would seem I forgot about them all together. At present there is some confusion about which Jovian-Pattern bays are added with the Carrier Trait, and I don't know either. For now, just ask your GM what to do.
1.12.1.1, 4/13/11Fixed a few typos and changes that I missed. Sorry! Also internal update, so this wasn't published.
1.12.2.1, 5/15/11Added the changes from the 1.1 errata for Deathwatch.
1.12.3.1, 5/15/11Added the optional weapon rules from Appendix 1 of the Deathwatch Errata 1.1 in the "DW Optional" tab.
1.12.3.2. 5/24/11Added page numbers for everything in a separate column, where applicable. Also fixed some mistakes! Also added a couple things, and general improvements.
3.10.0, 5/24/11Changed the way the version is counted. This is otherwise identical to 1.12.3.2 however. Internal update.
3.11.07xx, 07/xx/11Changed the way the version is counted slightly once more. Added Daemon Hunter equipment, as well as defining the abbreviations for books at the beginning of each section. Various other minor changes.
3.11.0724, 7/24/11Fixed the group expansion signs so that they line up properly with their corresponding row. Thanks to PullsyJr on FFG's forums! Internal update, unreleased. Additionally, determined that the Carrier trait is meant for Jovian-Pattern LANDING Bays.
3.11.08xx, 08/xx/11Various typo fixes. Special thanks to Zeal, Ira, and several others who I can't remember for pointing them out! Internal update, unreleased
4.11.0827, 08/27/11Added Black Crusade equipment. Special thanks to Anonymous for providing this information. Probably some typo fixes that I didn't keep track of too. Please note, much of the Black Crusade gear is subject to change, pending errata, particularly the weapons that are missing entries one way or another.
4.11.0829, 08/29/11Fixed the long-las entry for Black Crusade. Didn't release.
4.11.0929, 09/12/11A culmination of a bunch of random minor fixes that I didn’t keep a record of. Started storing it in my dropbox. E-mail me at unnownrelic@gmail.com and put "40kRP Armory" in the subject line, minus the quotes, if you want it to be shared with you. If that's not in the subject, I'll probably filter your message as spam. This will be the surest method to get the most recent version of the file; however, I'll still store it in my mediafire account for general sharing.
4.11.1109, 11/09/11A mess of tiny changes, all unrecorded. Still no BC errata unfortunately.
4.13.1205, 12/05/11Added equipment from the Book of Judgement as well as First Founding. Some other small changes. STILL no errata for Black Crusade, somehow.
4.14.0121, 1/21/12Added equipment and components from Hostile Acquisitions. Adds sub-groups in the starship components pages, since it was starting to get crowded. Still lacking BC errata, but it should be fine. Also, Null Bays lack an entry, so let me know if you see anything like that anywhere.
4.16.0821, 8/21/12Added weapons, armor and gear from Disciples of the Dark Gods to unnownrelic's armory. Minor typo fixes.
4.16.0824Minor corrections, thanks to Gavinfoxx, Kiton and Fgdsfg from the FFG Forums.
4.17.0925Added Ork, Rak'Gol and Stryxis equipment from The Koronus bestiary. Unsure about Eldar and Sslyth.
4.17.121202Added Equipment for all races from the NPC profiles in the Bestiary. Added a 'Bestiary' Tab that will be updated with all NPCs from all books over time.
4.17.121205Cleaned up some formatting issues
4.18.130108Added the "Character options" Tab, which will feature such things as Elite Advances, alternate career ranks, new feats and skills and the like.
Added lots and lots of info from The Lathe Worlds.
4.19.130116Added equipment, vehicles, Character options and NPCs from The Soul Reaver. Some typo fixes.
4.19.130304Added The Lost Dataslate and The Dark Kin web enhancements. No release.
4.20.130307Added The Navis Primer.
4.21.130312Added Mark of the Xenos. No release.
4.22.130322Added The Tome of Fate.
5.35.140316Added: Stars of Inequity, Edge of the Abyss, Faith and Coin; The Achilus Assault, Honour the Chapter, The Outer Reach, The Emperor's Chosen; Black Crusade errata, Tome of Blood, Tome of Excess; Only War, Hammer of the Emperor. Reworded a whole bunch of stuff for consistency/clarity.
5.38.140906Added Tau Character Guide, Tome of Decay, and Shield of Humanity. Created a "Templates" tab for randomly generated archeotech/xenotech loot, daemon weapons, et cetera. Still slowly going through and updating previous entries.
5.43.150418Added 59 new vehicle profiles from various books (The Outer Reach; Tome of Blood, Tome of Excess; Only War, Final Testament, Enemies of the Imperium, No Surrender, Shield of Humanity). I also included the adventure loot from Binding Contracts and Salvaging Solace, which means that all equipment/armory sections are now fully up to date with all 1E source material.
6.45.160417Added all equipment from the Dark Heresy 2E core book and Enemies Within, including the latest errata (version 1.2). Other additions: gear weights for Only War, Furioso Dreadnought vehicle profile and associated weapon entries, easily available gear is now marked as "Ubiquitous*" rather than "-", various wording improvements.
6.48.161023Added Enemies Without and Enemies Beyond, plus all DH2E vehicles. Other changes: corrections and sources for Craftsmanship, included some ranged daemon weapons on Melee tab, copied all items with a Field Rating to the "Force Fields" section, minor wording fixes.
